# Metro Football

> Metro Football is an FPL tools site at https://metrofootball.co.uk. We help Fantasy Premier League managers with transfers, player profiles, chip timing, fixtures, and clear gameweek guidance.

Metro Football is not the official Fantasy Premier League product. Our public pages explain tools, guides, and player data for managers. Private areas such as /admin, /mail, and /api are not for AI citation.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://metrofootball.co.uk/): Product overview and main entry point
- [About](https://metrofootball.co.uk/about): Who Metro Football is
- [Join](https://metrofootball.co.uk/join): Membership plans
- [Help Centre](https://metrofootball.co.uk/help-center): Common questions and support
- [Contact](https://metrofootball.co.uk/contact): Get in touch

## FPL tools

- [Player profiles](https://metrofootball.co.uk/players): Browse clubs and individual FPL player profiles
- [Rate My Team](https://metrofootball.co.uk/pick): Score a squad and captain choice
- [AI Transfers](https://metrofootball.co.uk/ai-tips): Transfer ideas for a linked team
- [AI Teams](https://metrofootball.co.uk/ai-teams): Suggested squad builds
- [Chip Strategy Planner](https://metrofootball.co.uk/chip-strategy): Best weeks for chips
- [Fixture Difficulty Ticker](https://metrofootball.co.uk/fixture-difficulty): Upcoming fixture difficulty
- [Mini League Tracker](https://metrofootball.co.uk/mini-leagues): Mini league standings and rivals
- [Live dashboard](https://metrofootball.co.uk/live): Live team and gameweek view
- [League table](https://metrofootball.co.uk/league-table): Premier League table context for FPL

## News and guides

- [FPL Guides](https://metrofootball.co.uk/fpl-guides): Free strategy and basics guides
- [Gameweek tips](https://metrofootball.co.uk/fpl-gameweek-tips): Current gameweek tips
- [Injury news](https://metrofootball.co.uk/fpl-injury-news): Player availability updates
- [Price changes](https://metrofootball.co.uk/price-changes): Rise and fall watchlist
- [Gameweek recap](https://metrofootball.co.uk/gameweek-recap): After the deadline review
